Taylor (Finance): Heads-up — I'm seeing ~ $14,800 in untagged GCP GPU charges for Feb across multiple projects. Billing export rows have null labels. Anyone own this? :eyes:

Maya (Cloud Infra): yikes. which projects?

Taylor (Finance): Top hits from a quick BigQuery pull below. I can share full CSV.

Taylor (Finance): ```sql
SELECT service.description, project.id as project, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXX`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%GPU%' AND labels IS NULL
GROUP BY project, service.description
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

billing-bot: automated billing export finished at 2026-02-20T09:00Z (export_id: exp_20260220_0900)

Ravi (Eng Platform): I think infra-sandbox had an autoscaler run during the Feb stress test (14th). Some transient pools spun up without our usual instance templates so the label hook didn't run.

Sofia (ML Infra): ML experiments team ran a big sweep on 2026-02-14 too — used preemptible VMs via a one-off script. I didn't add cost_center labels for those experiments, sorry. estimate ~ $4k.

Maya (Cloud Infra): okay. I'll run the full BQ query and post top projects. Also check audit logs to map instance names -> owner.

billing-bot: quick summary (from BQ): infra-sandbox: $7,900; ml-experiments-2: $4,150; unlimited-builds-prod: $2,750; other smalls: $0.

Alex (Product): That eats into the model infra budget. Can we reallocate to team budgets or do chargebacks? We need to approve transfers before EOD to not break monthly reporting. :money_with_wings:

Taylor (Finance): For finance to approve we need: 1) proposed allocation per team/project, 2) supporting evidence (audit log linking instances to owners), 3) an approval ticket (Jira). Also want budget alerts set at 80% for those projects.

Ravi (Eng Platform): I can map VM name prefixes -> service owners quickly. For the autoscaled pools, mapping is clear. For ad-hoc scripts we might have to ask owners (Sofia?). We can do a provisional split: Platform $7,900 -> infra, ML $4,150 -> ML team, remaining $2,750 -> CI/builds. Taylor, can you OK provisional allocations while we gather logs?

Taylor (Finance): Provisional OK pending logs. I'll open billing ticket and cc legal/compliance for cross-charge. Please add expected invoice impact.

Maya (Cloud Infra): I'll create a daily BQ view and send a 6am digest to #finance with rows where labels IS NULL. Also proposing an org policy to require 'cost_center' and 'team' labels on VM create; infra can deny creates without tags. Need infra/security sign-off. @Ravi @Sofia

Ravi (Eng Platform): I'll add tag enforcement to our infra-as-code and a pre-merge check for instance templates. Short-term we can add a deployment guard that rejects deployments without labels.

Sofia (ML Infra): Agreed. I'll also add a note in the ML runbook and update the sweep script to set labels automatically.

Taylor (Finance): Can someone paste the exact BQ command you run so we can reproduce? Also set a monthly budget with alerts. Suggested: budget for infra-sandbox $10k/month, ml-experiments-2 $5k/month, unlimited-builds-prod $3k/month with email to #finance and owners at 80/90/100%.

Maya (Cloud Infra): BQ query I ran above; gcloud budgets create snippet below:```bash
gcloud alpha billing budgets create --billing-account=012345-6789AB-CDEF01 --display-name="infra-sandbox-gpu" --amount=10000 --thresholds=0.8,0.9,1.0 --notifications-email=finance@redwood.com```

Ravi (Eng Platform): For retro allocation, we can tag the billing export rows in our internal charge system by matching instance IDs -> team and post an internal journal entry. That needs Finance + Eng Platform approvals.

Taylor (Finance): sounds good. I'll approve provisional journal entries today once you drop the audit mappings. Please open a Jira ticket for the chargeback with attachments.

billing-bot: logging action: created billing-ticket BT-9821 (provisional allocation hold)

Alex (Product): let's also add a postmortem note so PMs know budget hit and we can consider rate-limits on experimental runs.

Sofia (ML Infra): will do.

Maya (Cloud Infra): I will follow up with the detailed BQ export and the audit mapping by EOD.

Taylor (Finance): thanks all. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 PT in #finance to finalize allocations. :thumbsup:
